[h2]📢 Patch Notes – v0.46.01[/h2][p]🗓️ Release Date: August 9, 2025[/p][p]This update brings fresh horror elements along with system improvements and bug fixes.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🗺️ [b]Map Loading Issue Fixed[/b]

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – v.0.44.01
notes.content:
[p]📢 [b]Patch Notes – v.0.44.01[/b][/p][p]A fresh update is here! This patch focuses on improving user experience and fixing several annoying issues. Here’s what’s new:

🔄 [b]Return to Lobby System[/b]
You can now return directly to the lobby after a match ends. No more jumping back to the main menu — just hit the button and get ready for the next round with your team![/p][p]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]Invite Menu Update[/b]
Player names in the invite menu will now be truncated with “...” if they exceed 10 characters, keeping the UI clean and readable.[/p][p]🔊 [b]Audio Mute Fixes[/b]
Several sound effects that were not muting correctly have been fixed. Your volume controls should now behave as expected.[/p][p]⚙️ [b]Unified DLSS Settings[/b]
DLSS settings are now routed through a single unified control point. This ensures better compatibility and smoother configuration.[/p][p]🕊️ [b]Bird & Jump Bug Fixes[/b]
Bugs related to bird animations and the jump mechanic have been addressed. Expect smoother behavior during gameplay.[/p][p]📦 [b]Jump Animation Added to Props[/b]
Props now respond to jump actions with proper animations, enhancing environmental interactivity.[/p][p]🚀 [b]Optimization Improvements[/b]
Performance optimizations are ongoing. Current focus is on improving the experience on [i]High[/i] quality settings — early results look promising![/p][hr][/hr][p]Your feedback helps us a ton!
Reach out via \[discord.gg/trianglect] and help shape the future of [i]Triangle Cursed Town[/i]. 🎮[/p][p]Thanks for playing — and good hunting!
— [i]Triangle Cursed Town[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 📢 CLosed Beta Test UPTADE – v.0.39.000
notes.content:
[h2]📢 Beta Test – [i]v.0.39.000[/i][/h2][h3]🔥 Difficulty Modes & System Improvements[/h3][p]Hey Investigators,
Big changes are here! With this [b]Beta Update[/b], we’re laying the groundwork for more dynamic, scalable gameplay. Choose your difficulty, explore the improvements, and help us test what’s coming next.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 [b]New Difficulty Modes: Easy / Medium / Hard[/b][/h3][p]You can now select your preferred challenge level directly from the updated UI![/p][hr][/hr][p]⚙️ Difficulty-Based Adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]📡 [b]EMF Behavior[/b]: Spawn chance and detection range now scale with difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]🔦 [b]UV & Spectral Traces[/b]: Easier modes offer more clues, harder ones demand sharper eyes.[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Sanity Drain[/b]: Duration and loss rates are now difficulty-dependent.[/p][/*][*][p]👹 [b]Demon Hunt Speed[/b]: Faster and more aggressive on Hard.[/p][/*][*][p]⏱️ [b]Hunt Start Delay[/b]: Shorter delays on harder settings = less time to react.[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 [b]Hunt Trigger Chance[/b]: More frequent in higher difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Translation Fixes & Green Info Screens[/b]: Minor localization improvements and new difficulty-specific info panels.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Fixes & Experimental Features:[/h3][list][*][p]🧩 [b]Phase 2 Entry Bug[/b]: Fixed issue where players couldn't enter Phase 2 after dying. Needs further testing.[/p][/*][*][p]🧍 [b]Lobby Overlap Glitch[/b]: Fixed overlapping player models in the lobby. Still under test.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]DLSS & VSync Options Added[/b] [i](Experimental)[/i]: These features are now available in settings but are not fully functional yet — in progress.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 [i]We're in active testing — your feedback is crucial![/i]
Join our Discord or contact us via email to report bugs or share suggestions.[/p][p]👻 Stay sharp and good hunting,
– [i]Triangle Cursed Town Dev Team[/i][/p]
